title: SavoirFaire – Creative Agency
description: SavoirFaire is a premium creative agency page with a sophisticated dark editorial aesthetic. Uses large photography hero with overlaid text that creates immediate visual impact. Scroll-triggered image reveals and smooth transitions between sections create a cinematic browsing experience. Elegant serif typography for headings paired with clean sans-serif for body text. Portfolio showcases use a masonry grid with varying image sizes for visual rhythm. The color palette of deep blacks, warm grays, and gold accent conveys luxury and craftsmanship. Each project case study uses full-bleed imagery with subtle parallax. The footer is minimal, continuing the editorial magazine feel throughout.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for creative agencies, luxury brands, and portfolio showcases needing an editorial, cinematic, photography-forward page.
style_vibe: Luxury editorial agency aesthetic with cinematic photography, serif elegance, gold accents, and immersive scroll-triggered image reveals.
